desc:
👗 Welcome to Dress Shop Tycoon! Run the trendiest dress shop in the city: dress mannequins, style the perfect outfits and become a fashion tycoon!

💸 A rich VIP pulls up in her sports car with bodyguards… and pays 5x!
🏆 Make the best-selling looks and land on the Top Looks podium!

How to play:
👚 Style your mannequins with the latest outfits
💳 Ring up shoppers and count their change at the register
🚪 Unlock fitting rooms, hire staff and expand your shop
🏗️ NEW 3D Build Mode: design your shop from above, move everything and build upstairs!
🛋️ 60+ furniture & decor models: sofas, lamps, rugs, mirrors, plants…
🎨 Paint walls, floors and furniture to make the store your own
📋 Complete Daily Quests for extra cash

🆕 UPDATE 1: Grand opening!

👍 Like the game and join the group for an EXCLUSIVE outfit!
💻 Play on desktop, mobile, tablet and console
